caption: The drawing features a wooden wall-mounted box or shelf, depicted in a brown color with visible wood grain texture. The box has a flat base and vertical sides that curve upward and outward with a decorative shape. The backboard of the box extends higher than the sides, with the top edge cut in a curved, ornamental form. Two small round holes are visible in the upper section of the backboard, indicating where the object might be fastened to a wall. The background is plain and off-white or cream in color. Near the bottom right corner, there is handwritten text with the name "Alois E. Ulrich." A small brown blemish or stain appears above the top edge of the box on the paper.
title: Shaker Wooden Wall Shelf
